niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, modern interfaces that feel airy but still information-rich: light backgrounds, strong visual hierarchy, clear section grouping, and prominent readable controls. They like screens that are spacious and polished rather than crowded or heavy, but they also want enough content, labels, and actions visible to feel complete and useful. They tend to favor direct, task-focused flows with obvious next steps, clear status cues, and well-scannable lists or cards.

criteria.description: Prefers light, airy, modern-looking interfaces with low visual heaviness and a refined, polished feel.
Prefers large, bold, immediately legible titles with concise supporting text and strong emphasis on the main heading.
Prefers layouts with breathing room, balanced spacing, and less crowding or excessive vertical emptiness.
Prefers content organized into distinct, coherent sections or cards with clear separation and hierarchy.
Prefers screens that show enough settings, rows, labels, and details at once to feel complete and scannable.
Prefers obvious primary actions and controls, including visible buttons, toggles, and per-item actions that are easy to scan.
Prefers straightforward, task-oriented flows with clear progression, explicit next steps, and minimal unnecessary detours.
Prefers strong contrast and vivid accent colors that make key elements, controls, and status states stand out clearly.
Prefers explicit status indicators, recognizable labels, and identity cues such as counts, names, numbers, avatars, or partial identifiers.
